Merge pull request #1 from OpenBoardroom/task/BR-11

[BR-11] Backend foundation: schema, published views, EDGAR discovery and fetch

[BR-11] UPDATE: match the foundation plan to the code and add a pipeline runbook

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

[BR-11] FIX: stop fetch when EDGAR refuses us and harden the EDGAR client

Stop the fetch run on HTTP 403, 429, 5xx, or a network error instead of
sending every remaining filing another refused request; report each
per-filing failure as it happens. Re-read the clock after the rate
limiter sleeps, turn invalid or non-object JSON into EdgarError, and
treat an empty primaryDocument as missing in discover and fetch.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

[BR-11] FIX: widen membership matching for short discovery windows

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

[BR-11] FIX: judge membership over a lookahead from the filing date
